attempts.why: both halves of consent were present -- readback_now and agreed_now -- so the WRITE-ORDER gate should pass it, and that is what this replay asserts. In production it was held anyway, by the SPELLING gate: the caller's name had not been spelled yet, which is LVX77's lesson. The replay runs with VOICE_SPELL_POLICY=off so that gate's decisions do not masquerade as this one's, and tests/liveWritePathEndToEnd.test.js owns the spelling half.
